risks: Art resolution: the bundled muscle and hero art is 512×512 PNG at 177–447KB each, and rank_b.png is 1254px at 1.78MB. A full-bleed stage at 3× needs about 1024px. Mitigation: re-export the 7 muscle PNGs, 2 hero PNGs and all rank crests as 1024px webp (about 60–90KB each) before the Home redesign, and until then cap stage art at 256pt.

The lime is baked into the art. In deload a large green figure contradicts the glacier accent at hero size. Mitigation: under [data-deload=1], apply filter hue-rotate(100deg) saturate(.8) to bundled art, tuned on device, or ship deload webp variants. The pack's own deload_* pieces need nothing.

Display type versus real data: 56px Arabic day words assume short names. Custom or AI-imported plan names like 'Upper Body Hypertrophy' will not fit. Mitigation: map known splits to one word (سحب/دفع/أرجل/علوي/سفلي/جسم كامل); otherwise drop to --t-headline 34 with a 2-line clamp, plus clamp(44px,14vw,56px).

Mixing two faces: Archivo digits inside Changa sentences can sit high or low, or look too big. Mitigation: tune size-adjust and ascent-override on the Latin @font-face on a real iPhone, and proof the 30 most-used strings at 13px. Broadcast width (62%) is allowed only at 34px and above.

Editorial intensity can fight the gym utility: imagery must never cost the lifter a set row. Mitigation: one stage per screen, and in the player the stage collapses after the first set, with the 320×568 acceptance test. Stages never autoplay video under reduced motion.

A near-black ground plus matte-black figures can merge into a silhouette and smear on OLED while scrolling. Mitigation: the spotlight radial is mandatory behind any 3D art, and the ground stays #030404, never #000.

Two visual languages during migration: with 1271 inline styles, screens restyle at different times. Mitigation: phase 1 re-skins the whole app through token aliases (368× var(--font-ar), 264× var(--text3), 186× var(--cyan), 151× var(--font-mono) already route through variables), so the remaining differences are layout, not colour or type.
IA change: four tabs plus an avatar breaks the owner's muscle memory and touches App.jsx routing (NAV_TABS at constants.js:940-946). Mitigation: it is the last phase, behind a one-release toggle.

Performance: full-bleed images on Home and the player cost decode time on older iPhones. Mitigation: decoding='async', explicit aspect boxes so nothing reflows (as ExerciseMedia.jsx already does with 3/2), and content-visibility on report chapters.
Bundle discipline: importing from the Phosphor package root could pull in thousands of icons. Mitigation: import per icon from dist/csr, and add a build-size check to CI.
directions.migration:
PHASE 0, groundwork with no visual change (1–2 small PRs). (a) Delete the dead code in F58: StatsPage, HistoryPage, TodayPage, AIPanel, ChallengesPage, CalendarHeatmap, BarChart, Btn, .glass-card/.gradient-card and their deload overrides. This also removes every use of var(--text4), which index.css never defines; all 17 uses live in AIPanel, CalendarHeatmap, StatsPage, TodayPage and HistoryPage. (b) Add tests/style-ratchet.test.mjs to the npm test list. It counts style={{ objects (1271 today) plus literal fontSize, borderRadius, padding/margin/gap and hex values in src/**/*.jsx, and fails if any count rises above a committed baseline JSON. (c) Add tests/no-emoji-ui.test.mjs with a GREETINGS/celebration allowlist. (d) Add a /kitchen-sink route and have scripts/screens.mjs capture every screen in normal mode and in data-deload=1 as visual regression.

PHASE 1, tokens through aliases (one PR that re-skins the app with almost no JSX edits). (a) Self-host the fonts: public/fonts/meran-ar.woff2 (Changa Arabic subset, 22.9KB) and meran-lat.woff2 (Archivo wdth 62–100 / wght 500–800 Latin subset, 28.1KB), declared with unicode-range. Delete index.html:13-15, the google-fonts route at vite.config.js:46-52 and the 9 Zanjabeel OTFs (360KB). (b) Rewrite design-system/tokens.css with the Floodlight names and import it in src/main.jsx before index.css. (c) In index.css, keep the legacy names as aliases for one release: --bg → --ground; --bg1/--bg2 → --surface-1; --bg3 → --surface-3; --border/--border2 → --hairline/--surface-3; --text/--text2/--text3 → --ink/--ink-2/--ink-3; --cyan/--cyan-rgb/--green → --accent/--accent-rgb; --gold → --raise; --purple/--blue → --rest; --red → --danger; and BOTH --font-ar and --font-mono → the 'Meran Arabic','Meran Latin' stack. Because the inline styles already go through var() (368× --font-ar, 264× --text3, 186× --cyan, 151× --font-mono, 134× --border, 91× --bg3), most of the app changes colour and type in this one PR. Routing --font-mono through the unicode-range stack stops Arabic ever rendering in the numeral face at all 151 call sites. (d) Flatten --grad-primary to --accent and rewrite .btn-cyan as the new primary with an #06130A label; this updates its 12 class uses and the 9 inline var(--grad-primary) uses at once. Turn glowPulse, iconGlow, shimmer and auraPulse into no-ops. Make .page-enter opacity-only (index.css:282). Add the global prefers-reduced-motion block and the motion tokens. Set theme-color to #030404 (index.html:12 and the manifest). (e) Update design-system.json in the same PR (colors, fontSize, radius, rules 6, 12 and 13, the reward→raise note) so the docs and the code never disagree.

PHASE 2, primitives (2–3 PRs). Build CSS classes in index.css plus thin wrappers in src/components/ui/: .t-* text roles, <Num>/<Weight>/<Odometer>, <Icon> over @phosphor-icons/react per-icon imports, <IconButton> (44 hit area), <Button> (lg 56 / md 44 / sm 36 × primary/secondary/plain/destructive), <Chip>, <Segmented>, <Switch>, <TextField>/<Search>, <ListGroup>/<ListRow>, <Stage> (spotlight, art tiers, deload filter), <Sheet>/<ConfirmSheet>/<FullScreenCover> on <dialog>.showModal(), <Banner> and <LiveBar>. Rule from here on: inline style only for dynamic values (widths, transforms, CSS custom properties such as --card-edge). Re-export the art as 1024px webp in this phase.

PHASE 3, screens, highest impact first, one PR each. Every PR deletes that screen's inline literals and lowers the ratchet baseline. Order: (1) Workout player → session cover + LiveBar + SessionSummary (WorkoutPlayer, ExerciseHero, WorkingArea, InlineRest, SetHistory); (2) Home (HomePage, TodayHero); (3) Exercise library + exercise sheet + shared ExercisePicker; (4) Achievements + level-up and deload-end covers; (5) Profile; (6) Settings split into src/pages/settings/; (7) Monthly report + reportPoster, which reads a generated JS token module and replaces FAMILY at reportPoster.js:32 and the typed wordmark at :229-230. Each PR ships screenshots in both modes, diffed against the previous capture.

PHASE 4, IA behind a one-release toggle. Four tabs: الرئيسية · السجل · التقدم · المكتبة. Profile is reached from the Home avatar, Settings is pushed from Profile, and achievements become a segment of التقدم. Then delete the aliases with a codemod.

Exit targets: style={{ objects from 1271 to under 200; distinct fontSize from 32 to 8; borderRadius from 17 to 4; UI emoji outside the allowlist from about 500 to 0; hex literals in JSX from 84 to 0, the remaining canvas colours coming from the token module. Every phase is releasable on its own.

directions.thesis: Meran stops being a dashboard and becomes a coach. Today every screen asks Hamza to read everything at once. page-home stacks a two-line greeting, a permanent «اضغط ⚙️» hint, a 🔥60 pill, ⏱ and ⚙ tiles, a 3D dumbbell-arm clip art, a white-on-gradient ⚡ CTA, a mono «Lv 4 · E مبتدئ» strip with five droplet flames, and «W2/6» plus Latin Push/Pull/Legs bubbles. The 'old digital app' feeling comes from the game-HUD language: Oxanium numerals (index.css:79), neon gradient-and-glow buttons (index.css:91, ui.jsx:36-41), boxes nested in bordered boxes on a blue-black navy ladder (index.css:19-24), emoji used as icons (🫁 on الصدر, 🗂️ for back, 📚 in the tab bar) and English game words («!LEVEL UP», «sets 0/5», «DELOAD COMPLETE»). Rafiq answers with voice, restraint and softness. Every screen opens with one coach sentence in the Saudi house voice that already exists (constants.js:17) and offers exactly one pressable thing to do now. Everything else is quiet: warm graphite surfaces instead of navy, one soft Arabic-Latin family (Rubik) shipped offline, Phosphor duotone icons, and a flat two-tone illustration family drawn as inline SVG, so the offline fallback is the intended art. Rewards stay (XP, ranks, streak, tickets) but become rare, illustrated and played once. Then the screen goes still so the lifter can lift. It takes Duolingo's warmth and tactility and Fitbod's 'here is today's workout, start it'. It stays premium by banning the cartoon parts: no mascot, no infinite loops, no glow, one accent per screen.
references: Duolingo: streak flame and 7-day week strip, pressable lip buttons that sink on tap, session-complete beat sheet (stats count up, then streak, then XP), speech-bubble coach voice. Taken without the mascot or multi-colour confetti.
Fitbod: dark UI, one 'today's workout' card with one Start button, the exercise list visible before starting, muscle map, e1RM trend per exercise.
Strong / Hevy: set table with a «السابق» column, tap-to-copy last values, live workout that minimises to a bar above the tab bar.
Apple Fitness / Activity: full-screen workout summary cover, large titles that collapse into a 44pt bar, inset grouped Settings lists, 44pt targets.
Headspace: a warm flat illustration family with a limited palette and faceless rounded figures, the tone for empty states and celebrations.

Phosphor Icons (MIT, @phosphor-icons/react 2.1.10): regular, fill and duotone weights on one 256 grid. Every name used here (barbell, flame, timer, moon, ticket, medal, crown, books, arrow-fat-up, lock-simple, play-circle, skip-forward, confetti, scales, calendar-check, chart-line-up …) was checked to exist in @phosphor-icons/core 2.1.1.

Rubik (OFL, Google Fonts, Arabic subset included): soft-cornered geometric with variable weight 300-900 and tnum/pnum. Checked with fontTools on the Google Fonts TTF and rendered next to Changa at the app's real strings.
Baloo Bhaijaan 2 (OFL, Ek Type): rounded Arabic+Latin display face, wght 400-800, tnum. Used only for celebration numerals.
Material 3 Expressive and Apple HIG: one gentle spring for celebration entrances, standard curves for everything else, Reduce Motion as a first-class state.

Cards and list groups, the week card, the tab bar (at 96%). 1.12:1 on ground, plus a 6% hairline as glare insurance.

Primary text and every live numeral. 12.3:1 even on surface-3.
Secondary text, player meta, chrome icons, neutral XP/level bars. 8.1:1 on surface-3.
Captions, placeholders, the inactive tab, units («كجم»). The floor: 4.74:1 on surface-3, 6.05:1 on surface-1. Replaces #6E8899 and every #4B5563 literal.
Brand green, kept exactly. Used only for the one primary action per screen, the active tab, done checks and the selected state. 7.7:1 as text on surface-1.
The 4px solid lip under the primary button, and the pressed fill. Replaces the --grad-primary gradient and its glow (index.css:91).

Text on a gold fill (9.9:1).
Fill of the «+2.5 كجم عن آخر مرة» badge in the player.

Sheet and dialog backdrop (::backdrop at 64%) with no backdrop-filter, per the iOS compositing note at App.jsx:775-777.

Periwinkle, so rest never collides with the ice accent (index.css:632 logic kept).

typography.families: Two OFL families, both self-hosted as woff2 in public/fonts and precached by the existing globPatterns at vite.config.js:30, which already lists woff2. That way offline looks exactly like online. (1) Rubik, the single UI family for Arabic, Latin exercise names and every number. One variable woff2, wght 300-900, subset to Arabic + Basic Latin + punctuation + U+00D7/U+2212: 59 KB, measured by running fontTools subset on the Google Fonts TTF in the scratchpad. It has tnum and pnum, so numbers use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums in the same face. No separate mono, and the Arabic can never fall into a Latin-only face (F04). (2) Baloo Bhaijaan 2 at weight 800, the 'moment' face used only for celebration numerals and headlines (level number, summary volume, report cover hero, deload return weight). Its 58 KB subset can be lazy-preloaded on first celebration. @font-face uses font-display: block (precached, so no visible swap). Stack: 'Meran', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif, so iOS falls back to SF Arabic if a file is ever missing. Delete the Google Fonts links (index.html:13-15), the google-fonts runtime cache (vite.config.js:46-53), Oxanium, and the nine Zanjabeel OTFs (index.css:1-9, 360 KB). Net precache goes from 360 KB of OTF plus CDN fonts to 117 KB. Rules: letter-spacing 0 on all Arabic; every numeric or Latin run sits in <Num> = <bdi dir=ltr> with tabular-nums; sizes are authored in rem on html{font:-apple-system-body} (17px default) and capped with min(...,20px) for body roles. Live numerals use fixed clamps so Dynamic Type can't break the player.

scale.use: The floor; nothing Arabic goes below it. Meta, dates, tab labels (weight 600 in both states so labels don't reflow), chart axes, the set-table header (600), units.
Chips, eyebrows, sm buttons, list subtitles (500), the hero meta line, banners, the player coach line.
Descriptions, tip bodies, sheet prose, settings explanations. Use 1.35 when the text is one line.
List-row titles, button labels (lg 700), the nav-bar title, the exercise name in the player (2-line clamp, text-wrap: balance).
The Home coach line (2-line clamp, at most 44 characters), card and sheet titles, the profile name.
Large screen titles (collapsing to 44pt), the hero day title «ظهر وبايسبس».
Rubik tabular, fixed clamp(34px,2.35rem,44px): weight and reps steppers, the rest countdown, the week streak numeral, report stat figures.
Baloo Bhaijaan 2 tabular, celebrations only: level numeral, summary volume, report cover number (auto-fit down to 48 for 7 digits), deload return weight.

radii.use: Thumbnails (exercise and muscle), the 32px icon tiles, fields inside cards, the small raise badge, poster tiles.
Cards, list groups, all buttons (lg 56pt / md 44pt / sm 36pt), the coach bubble, the rest dock, the live bar, achievement tiles.
The hero card «الخطوة الجاية», sheet top corners, moment-cover cards, the poster card.
Chips, segmented track and thumb, avatars, steppers, progress tracks, the search field, the tab-bar capsule, day cells. Deload no longer changes radii, because temperature carries the mode.

directions.spacing: 4pt grid with seven steps: 4 · 8 · 12 · 16 · 24 · 32 · 48. 20 exists only as --hero-pad. Gutter: clamp(12px, 4.1vw, 16px), which gives 16 at 390pt and 13 on a 320pt SE. Card padding 16, hero padding 20. In-card gap 12, related controls 8, chip padding 6×12 (28pt tall, hit area expanded to 44). Section gap 24, with 12 between a section title and its content. List rows: 56 minimum, 64 with a subtitle, dividers inset 64 from inline-start. Hit area: 44 minimum everywhere, 56 for player controls (steppers, dock, set rows). Bottom content padding: tab bar 49 + safe area + 16, plus 56 while the live bar shows. Nesting is capped at two levels (page → card). Inside a card use hairline dividers or one inset well, never another bordered box. This replaces 122 padding literals and Card's default padding of 6 (ui.jsx:25). A ratchet test rejects any new literal outside {0,4,8,12,16,24,32,48}.
directions.elevation: Dark UI, so depth comes from a surface step plus a hairline, not shadow or glow. e0: ground. e1 card: surface-1 + box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #F5F4EE0F. e2 raised: surface-2 + the same inset hairline + inset 0 1px 0 #FFFFFF0D as a top light edge. e3 sheet/menu/toast: surface-3 + 0 -12px 40px #00000080 (the only drop shadow in the app), on the 64% scrim. The one physical exception is the lip. Primary button: box-shadow 0 4px 0 var(--accent-press). Steppers, choice cards and secondary buttons: 0 3px 0 #0A0B09 under surface-2. On press the control translates down by the lip height and the lip goes to 0 in 90ms, so it feels like a real key. No glow anywhere. Delete --cyan-glow / --glow-mul shadows, glowPulse and iconGlow, the ProgressBar glow (ui.jsx:172), the LevelUp halos and text-shadows (LevelUpScreen.jsx:17-29, 53), and the card drop shadows (ui.jsx:27). z-scale tokens: chrome 100, nav 200, live bar 210, sheet 700, dialog 800, toast 900, moment 1000. Every overlay is rendered through <dialog>.showModal() (top layer), so nothing is trapped under the header by the page-enter transform (index.css:282).
directions.iconography: Phosphor Icons (MIT), @phosphor-icons/react 2.1.10, tree-shaken ESM, so it ships inside the bundle and works offline. It suits an Arabic UI because its round caps and joins and soft geometry match Rubik's rounded Arabic, it has no letterforms inside glyphs, and its duotone weight gives the warm, companion feel without emoji. Weights carry roles: regular (16-unit stroke = 1.5px at 24) for chrome and rows; fill for the active tab and selected state; duotone (second tone at 20%) inside 32px feature tiles (r-sm, tinted with accent-wash or the status wash) for settings rows, banners, tips and empty-state headers. Sizes: 16 for chips and inline, 20 for rows, header actions and buttons, 24 for the tab bar. Always currentColor. Wrapped as <Icon name size weight> in src/components/ui/Icon.jsx with an explicit import map of about 45 names. Directional glyphs (caret-*, arrow-*, skip-*, sign-out) flip with scaleX(-1) under [dir=rtl]; play, timer, check and barbell never flip. Emoji mapping: ⏱️→timer, ⚙️→gear-six, 📚→books, ✏️→pencil-simple, 🗑️→trash, ▶️/YouTube tile→play-circle (neutral), ⏭️→skip-forward, ⇄→arrows-left-right, 🔒→lock-simple, ⭐→star, 🎟️→ticket, 🌙→moon, ♻️→arrows-clockwise, ⚠️→warning-circle, 📊→chart-bar, 🏆→trophy, ⚡ and 💪 deleted from labels (TodayHero.jsx:267). Phosphor has no anatomy, so the 8 muscle glyphs are custom, drawn on Phosphor's 256 grid with the same 16-unit stroke and the target region filled, used at 20-24pt only where no label sits beside them. Larger muscle imagery keeps the bundled muscle_*.png as 40-56pt thumbnails until the flat body map ships. The illustration family «رسومات مران» is a separate layer: flat, no outlines, no gradients, no 3D. Inks: surface-3 shapes, illus-cream highlights, the accent swoosh lifted from the logo as the signature in every piece, plus at most one state ink (streak, raise or rest). Faceless rounded figures, a 120 grid for spots and 240×160 for heroes, a budget of 3 KB or less per piece, shipped as React SVG in src/illustrations/. It replaces hero_training.png (TodayHero.jsx:51-52), the 👑/💪 celebration fallbacks (LevelUpScreen.jsx:38), the emoji medal fallback (AchievementsPage.jsx:178-182) and the gold 3D badges. The art pack keeps only exercise stills and loops and the monthly cover photos. Enforcement: tests/no-emoji-ui.test.mjs scans src/**/*.jsx for Extended_Pictographic outside GREETINGS and the celebration copy table.
directions.motion: Four principles. (1) Feedback is physical. On pointerdown the lip collapses in 90ms on --ease-standard; release springs back in 160ms; a haptic tick is added as progressive enhancement (navigator.vibrate on Android, the iOS 18 switch-input trick on iPhone), and no feedback depends on it. The action fires on tap and never waits for an animation: tapping the set dock starts rest instantly. (2) The coach celebrates once, then goes still. Celebrations run as beat sheets of at most 3s, with tap-anywhere jumping to the final frame. Entrances may use one gentle spring, cubic-bezier(0.34,1.36,0.64,1), capped at scale 1.04. A single 40-particle confetti burst uses accent, illus-cream and streak only, never gold. Nothing loops except the live-session dot (opacity only, 2.5s), so glowPulse, shimmer, iconGlow, ringExpand, the flame bob and tagPulse are all deleted. (3) Numbers count, they don't flash. Summary stats count up over 600ms; the streak rolls N→N+1 with a 400ms translateY; the level numeral rolls 3→4 over 420ms; the rest drain is a transform: scaleX layer timed with a negative animation-delay. (4) Space has direction. Sheets rise on --ease-sheet; pushed pages enter from the left in RTL; tab switches are instant (scroll position kept per tab); the player opens as a full-screen cover from the hero CTA and minimises into the live bar. Tokens, not multiplied by --breath: --dur-press 90ms, --dur-fast 160ms, --dur-base 240ms, --dur-sheet 360ms, --dur-moment 600ms; --ease-standard cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), --ease-exit cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1), --ease-sheet cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1). Only ambient loops use --breath. Reduce Motion: a global block sets durations to 0.01ms, celebrations show their final frame, video waits for a tap, and scrollIntoView uses 'instant'.
signatureMoves: «كلمة المدرب», the coach line: one data-aware sentence in the Saudi house voice with exactly one emoji, joined to the last word by U+00A0. Shown in a surface-2 speech bubble (r-md, a tail toward a 32px coach mark made from the logo's swoosh and diamond). Home: «حمزة، اليوم سحب — آخر مرة 75، نجرب 77.5؟ 💪». «الخطوة الجاية», one thing now: every screen has exactly one accent-filled, pressable action. Home's hero tells Hamza what to do today (start Pull, rest, log weight, finish the deload); everything else lives one tap behind it.

The pressable lip button: solid #5EC32A, a 4px #3F8C18 lip, a dark #0B2604 label, radius 16, 56pt. It sinks on press. This is Duolingo's best tactile idea executed quietly, and it replaces the gradient, the glow and the white label everywhere. The steppers use the same lip in neutral.

The living flame: a custom flat flame in four growth states by milestone (ember below 7, flame 7-29, flame with a green core 30-99, a cream-cored green flame at 100+), sitting on the 7-day week strip. Moment covers with beat sheets: Session summary, level-up, rank promotion, PR, streak milestone and deload end share one layout: a flat illustration, a Baloo Bhaijaan 2 numeral, the coach line, a 'كمّل' lip button and a 'شارك' ghost button. They play once, are queued during a session, and play inside the summary.

«رسومات مران», a flat two-tone illustration and medal family in SVG. Achievement medals are composed from 4 category emblems (sessions, streak, strength, volume) × 4 rarity frames with the badge's own threshold engraved («25», «5 طن»). That gives 40 distinct badges from 8 parts, all offline, with no gold (rarity goes common ring → rare double ring → epic accent ring → legendary accent ring with a cream star).

Temperature modes: normal is warm graphite plus leaf green; deload is cool graphite plus ice. The whole room changes temperature without a banner, keeping the 'one attribute moves everything' trick of index.css:614 against the new token names.

keeps: Dark-only.
Brand green #5EC32A exactly, still authored through an RGB triplet so a mode can move it (index.css:26-31 idea, renamed --accent-rgb).
Gold as the raise-the-weight and best-weight colour (role kept, hue nudged to #FBBF24 so it separates from streak orange).
The Saudi house voice with one emoji per greeting line (constants.js:17-21). It becomes the coach line rather than being trimmed.
The 03:00 training-day turn (day.js:5, todayKey) for the week strip, history grouping and streak-risk timing.
Deload as a whole-app mode set by one attribute (index.css:614-660). The ice accent is kept and the neutrals cool.
The game layer: XP, levels, E…S+ ranks, streak, rest tickets, achievements. Placed and drawn better, not removed.
The RaiseRing draw animation, moved onto the weight field.
The art pack for exercise stills and loops and the monthly cover photos (slots.js:62-75), plus the bundled muscle_*.png as interim thumbnails.
The monthly report and the 1080×1920 share poster pipeline.
node:test as the test runner; scripts/screens.mjs as visual regression.
risks: Duolingo-isation. A rounded display face, speech bubbles and confetti can read 'kids app' to a serious lifter. Mitigation: no mascot, Baloo limited to celebration numerals, one burst per moment, and a trial on the owner's phone before rollout. If it still reads young, swap t-moment to Rubik 800.

The warm graphite departs from the navy identity the owner is used to, and green on warm-olive darks can look muddy on some OLED panels. Mitigation: keep chroma very low (#0C0D0B is almost neutral) and proof on the real iPhone in both modes.

The illustration family is new production work: about 30 spots, 7 crests, 8 medal parts, 4 flames, 8 muscle glyphs. Uneven drawing would look worse than today. It also retires the paid 3D ach_* and scene_* slots (slots.js:28-38). The current achievement art is mostly gold (e.g. ach_strength.png, a gold fist), which breaks the gold rule anyway.
Rubik Arabic is younger and less proven at 12-13px than SF Arabic. The 30 most-used strings need proofing on device; the stack falls back to system-ui.
The lip adds 4px of visual height and motion. The action must fire on tap, not after the animation, and a lip on more than one control per screen dilutes the 'one thing now' rule.

Coach lines need data-aware copy. Repetitive or wrong lines ('77.5' when the engine says hold) would destroy trust. They need tests for length, emoji count and data source, and a generic fallback pool.
The IA change (4 tabs, Profile behind the avatar, Achievements inside التقدم) breaks muscle memory. Ship it in its own release with a one-time coach mark.
Mid-migration, inline style={{}} beats new classes, so half-migrated components can show mixed old and new styling. Each screen PR must delete the inline properties it replaces.
The iOS haptic trick (switch input) and AudioContext scheduling are platform hacks that can break with an iOS update. Visuals must carry every signal on their own.
directions.migration: Ratchet, not big bang. Every phase ships on its own and is checked with scripts/screens.mjs in normal and deload modes. Phase 0, fonts (S): add rubik-var.woff2 and baloo-800.woff2 to public/fonts with @font-face font-display: block; set --font-ar and --font-num to 'Meran'; delete index.html:13-15, vite.config.js:46-53, index.css:1-9 and the Zanjabeel OTFs. Phase 1, tokens with aliases (S, whole-app shift with no JSX edits): create src/styles/tokens.css with the new names (--ground, --surface-1..3, --inset, --line, --text/-2/-3, --accent/-rgb/-press/-ink/-wash, --raise, --streak, --rest, --danger, --r-sm/md/lg/pill, --space-*, --t-*, --dur-*, --ease-*, --z-*) and import it in main.jsx before index.css. Point the legacy names at them (--bg→--ground, --bg2→--surface-1, --bg3→--surface-2, --border→--line, --cyan(-rgb)→--accent(-rgb), --gold→--raise, --purple→--rest, --text3→--text-3, --radius→16px, --grad-primary→var(--accent)), rewrite the deload block against the new names, and set theme-color to #0C0D0B. The 1271 inline styles that already read var(--…) change palette at once. Design-system/tokens.css, which src never imports, is replaced by this file, and design-system.json is regenerated from it (color.reward becomes 'raise' with the new use rule). Phase 2, primitives as CSS classes plus thin components (M): src/components/ui/{Text, Num, Icon, IconButton, Button, Card, ListGroup, ListRow, Chip, Segmented, Switch, TextField, Banner, Sheet, ConfirmSheet, FullScreenCover, CoachLine, Medal}.jsx with src/styles/components.css. Inline styles are kept only for dynamic values. Add a kitchen-sink route captured by screens.mjs, and add @phosphor-icons/react. Phase 3, guards (S), added to npm test: tests/style-ratchet.test.mjs fails if counts rise above today's baseline (1271 style objects, 637 fontSize literals, 31 hex colours, 122 padding literals) or if a new literal falls outside the scales; tests/no-emoji-ui.test.mjs; tests/arabic-type.test.mjs (no mono or letter-spacing on U+0600-06FF). Each PR lowers the baseline. Phase 4, screens in order of daily pain, each PR deleting its own inline styles: (a) Player (WorkoutPlayer, WorkingArea, ExerciseHero, InlineRest, RestTimer) plus the live bar; (b) Home (HomePage, TodayHero) plus removal of the global header (App.jsx:768-848) plus the 4-tab bar; (c) the Session summary and level-up and deload-end covers; (d) Library plus the exercise sheet; (e) التقدم with Achievements; (f) Profile, then Settings split into src/pages/settings/*; (g) report and poster. Illustrations land per screen, with the emoji fallback kept until each SVG exists. Phase 5, cleanup (S): delete the aliases with a codemod, the dead pages and components (F58), .btn-cyan, .glass-card, .gradient-card, glow keyframes and the 25-icon Icons.jsx. Target: under 200 inline style objects, 8 font sizes, 4 radii, 0 emoji in UI chrome.

scores.rationale: Best fit for the 2-second glance from the bench. Today's player-working and player-se show the greeting header plus tab bar taking roughly a third of the height, a 3-4 line mono English name, the chest figure twice and no stepper above the fold. player-rest shows a 01:26 countdown in Oxanium and a red 'تخطي الراحة'. Floodlight answers with the largest live numerals of the three: 56px weight and reps with 56pt round controls, and a 56px countdown in a dock that grows to 168pt. At zero the dock wipes into a full-width green 'جاهز · المجموعة التالية' field you can read from across the bench without picking up the phone. On Arabic typography it is the strongest. It keeps Changa, the brand's existing face (index.css:78; index.html:15 loads it from Google today), self-hosts it, and splits scripts by unicode-range, so Arabic can never fall into the numeral face. That fixes the root cause of «عا دي», '!LEVEL UP' and «E · مبتدئ» (HomePage.jsx:223-227 sets the rank pill in var(--font-mono); LevelUpScreen.jsx:44-45 uses mono with letterSpacing 6). Changa is a condensed Kufi, so it handles long Saudi strings on a 320pt phone better than a wide face. The one-word day ('سحب / دفع / أرجل / راحة') and the broadcast numerals give Meran a Saudi sports-broadcast identity. That answers 'looks like an old digital app' with character rather than a generic iOS template, which suits a lifter who already likes the game layer. Weaknesses for this lens: (1) the 62%-condensed Archivo digits shrink the counters exactly where the glance matters most, on the live weight and countdown; (2) the dock CTA 'إنهاء المجموعة' shares the verb with the session-ending 'إنهاء' in the bar, an easy wrong read mid-set; (3) the gold raise ring loops forever (1.0s draw + 2.0s hold), which breaks its own one-beat-then-still rule; (4) a 168pt rest dock plus the live block can crowd an iPhone SE; (5) the full-bleed Home stage depends on re-exported 1024px art.

The most rigorous mid-set spec. Every screen is declared around one number or one action, with a manifest assertion behind it. The dock says 'تمّت المجموعة', which cannot be confused with ending the session. Rest starts on the tap and never waits for animation. Rest can be felt without looking: three 660 Hz ticks, an 880 Hz end tone and a wake lock. Skip is never red. The raise ring draws once and then stays still. The greeting gets a fixed 2.6em min-height so nothing below jumps. There is a 320×568 acceptance test. It also keeps the exact logo green and fixes the white-on-green label shown on page-home's CTA by switching to a dark label. For a 2-second glance it is weaker than Floodlight. The live numerals and the rest countdown are only 40px, and the rest dock is 72pt, adequate in the hand but not readable from the bench. On type, Alexandria is a clean geometric Arabic that sets cleanly with zero tracking, and Inter tabular digits are very legible. But Alexandria is wide (the direction itself notes the 13px plan line wraps where Changa fit), it drops the brand's Arabic voice, and with 600 as the ceiling for numerals it reads polished but generic. Culturally it keeps the dialect copy but tucks the game layer away. The risk is a WHOOP/Apple clone that feels cold to an owner who asked to 'keep up with the best global apps' and enjoys ranks and XP.

It has the best grasp of the Saudi voice. A data-aware coach line ('حمزة، اليوم سحب — آخر مرة 75، نجرب 77.5؟ 💪') turns the dialect copy into guidance. The one-line player cue 'آخر مرة 75×12 — جرّب 77.5' is exactly what a lifter wants at a glance. Composed SVG medals fix the inverted reward offline: page-achievements today shows earned badges as 🌱/🏋 emoji on grey tiles. Under this lens it is the weakest. Live numerals are 40px and the rest dock is 64pt. The 4px 'lip' on buttons adds tactility visually but not hit area or confidence for sweaty fingers. Rubik's Arabic is the least refined of the three faces at 12-13px, and the direction admits it needs proofing. Pairing it with Baloo Bhaijaan 2 for celebrations pushes toward a playful kids'-app register, which does not fit a serious Saudi gym-goer's idea of premium. Speech bubbles and confetti add to that. Warm olive graphite risks looking muddy on OLED. The flat illustration family (about 30 spots, crests, medal parts, flames) is a large art project, and if it is drawn unevenly it will look worse than today. The coach line on Home also takes a speech bubble's worth of height.

grafts: From Calm Instrument: rename the dock CTA to 'تمّت المجموعة' (and 'جاهز · المجموعة التالية' at zero), so the only 'إنهاء' on the player is the session-end text button. Sweaty, hurried taps must not meet the same verb twice.

From Calm Instrument: draw the gold raise ring once (raiseDraw, then still) instead of Floodlight's infinite 1.0s draw + 2.0s hold loop. The gold weight numeral and the '+2.5 كجم عن آخر مرة' badge carry the signal on their own.

From Calm Instrument: set live input numerals (weight and reps steppers, rest countdown) at Archivo font-stretch 85-100% rather than 62%. Keep the 62% broadcast width for read-only hero numbers (report total, level, streak) where nobody is reading mid-set from arm's length.

From Calm Instrument: rest you can feel without looking. Schedule three 660 Hz ticks and an 880 Hz end tone at the tap, start rest on the tap with no animation wait, hold a wake lock, and make 'تخطي' ink-2, never red.
